title: Add the company AI switch to Integrations
public_pr_body:
Add the existing company's AI on/off controls alongside Xero on Admin > Integrations, with a link from Settings. Reuse AiMasterCard and the existing authenticated settings endpoint; no second switch or SQL. Keep key and monthly spending controls in the AI section.

Scope AI status to the current person/company and ignore late responses from a previous company, so switching companies cannot display or overwrite the next company's AI state.

Claim: N2. Checked main and open PRs: AI controls existed on /ai-helper, but not Integrations.

Validation: 18 unit tests passed, including a real React DOM company-switch/late-response test and existing master-switch tests. Typecheck and targeted lint passed. Live browser/database/provider tests not run; no SQL applied. No docs files changed.
